quests.title: Quests
quests.emptyBody: Add your next exam, then scan your pages. Each exam becomes a path of short levels with a boss fight on exam day.

exams.title: My exams
exams.emptyBody: Add an exam in three taps: subject, date, done. Mentora plans your study days up to it.
exams.addHint: Opens a short form: subject, date, done

new.title: Add an exam
new.subject: Subject
new.saveHint: Saves the exam and returns to your list

detail.deleteConfirmBody: Its study plan and reminders are removed too.

add.title: What are we studying?
add.body: Scan pages, paste text or pick a topic from the curriculum.
add.scanHint: Book, notes, worksheet or the board

squad.title: Study squad
squad.emptyBody: Squads share one goal. They only see names, XP and levels, never your pages, grades or mistakes.

me.title: Me
me.calmModeDescription: Turns off XP, streaks, chests and boss fights. Your plan and reviews stay the same.
me.remindersDescription: At most one a day. Never during school hours or at night.
me.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off for Quest Note. Turn them on in your phone settings to get reminders.

account.title: Account
account.signedOut: Sign in to back up your exams and keep them when you change phones.

body.weekBefore: 10 minutes today starts your study plan.

body.dayBefore: Do your practice test, then get some sleep.
body.examMorning: A 2-minute warm-up is ready. Good luck!

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: We'll email you a {{digits}}-digit code. No password to remember.
auth.emailHint: Use an email you can open on this phone.
auth.emailInvalid: Check the email address. It should look like name@example.com.
auth.codeIntro: We sent a {{digits}}-digit code to {{email}}. It can take a minute to arrive.

errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
